en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Eating the broad-beans enhances the two thighs, and gives birth to the fresh blood’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Eating broad beans grows the bone marrow of the legs and produces fresh blood.’”
